authorization_scope: User explicitly requested cleanup of remote backed-up old data; local backups, GitHub, scripts and notes retained.
backup_verification: Fresh local file size/SHA checks, all 154 compressed pool members streamed and hashed; then remote file size/SHA/stat checked before unlink.
process_check_scope: Accessible same-user file descriptors and memory maps; recognized protected login services documented separately; other users are outside this visibility. Snapshot, not a concurrency lock.

protected_login_services_not_inspected.reason: Protected login service; FDs inaccessible, not asserted empty. Child workers are inspected separately.

restore_notice: Most exact copies are local private archives, not GitHub uploads. Keep those local archive directories. Before reusing old absolute paths, restore the listed exact file or tar member to its original location and verify SHA256; do not overwrite a newly created file.
preserved: No directories, scripts, Markdown notes, small metadata, unlisted files, local backup copies, models absent from backup manifests, or GitHub copies were deleted. All listed source directories remain; they are not standalone complete run environments after data retirement.
